changeSet.author: skillswipe
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users ( id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, telegram_id BIGINT NOT NULL UNIQUE, username TEXT, active_mode TEXT, consent_at TIMESTAMPTZ, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now() );

changeSet.author: skillswipe
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS resumes ( id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, user_id BIGINT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, s3_key TEXT NOT NULL, original_filename TEXT NOT NULL, extracted_text TEXT, extracted_data JSONB, processing_status TEXT NOT NULL, uploaded_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now() );

changeSet.author: skillswipe
skillswipe
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS skill_synonyms ( id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, skill_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES skills(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, synonym TEXT NOT NULL, lang TEXT );

changeSet.author: skillswipe
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS user_skills ( id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, user_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, skill_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES skills(id), UNIQUE (user_id, skill_id) );
